definitions.explanation: To officially accept applications, requests, or submissions; to handle reception of documents or visitors.
To be able to stomach or tolerate something; often used in negative form to indicate incompatibility.

examples.japanese: {申|もう}し{込|こ}みは{来週|らいしゅう}まで{受|う}け{付|つ}けています。
examples.english: We are accepting applications until next week.

examples.japanese: {苦情|くじょう}は{受|う}け{付|つ}けません。
{体|からだ}がアルコールを{受|う}け{付|つ}けない。

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{受|う}ける (to receive) + {付|つ}ける (to attach, to apply)

TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) - takes を

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予約|よやく}を{受|う}け{付|つ}ける: to accept reservations
- {申|もう}し{込|こ}みを{受|う}け{付|つ}ける: to accept applications
- {相談|そうだん}を{受|う}け{付|つ}ける: to accept consultations
- {体|からだ}が{受|う}け{付|つ}けない: body can't tolerate

RELATED NOUN:
- {受付|うけつけ}: reception desk, receptionist
